title: ag-cube-cm: spatial process-based crop model orchestration on climate and soil datacubes
description:
ag-cube-cm is a Python package for running process-based crop models over spatial domains. It reads climate and soil datacubes (CF-compliant NetCDF or Zarr), runs pixel-level simulations in parallel and produces gridded yield maps (grain yield, kg/ha) across planting windows, years and space.

Supported crop models:

  • DSSAT: maize, wheat, rice, soybean and other crops (bundled binary for Linux and Windows).
  • CAF2021: agroforestry model for coffee under shade trees.
  • SIMPLE: generic single-crop model.
  • Banana-N: banana growth and nitrogen dynamics.

ag-cube-cm is the crop-modelling layer of a two-package workflow with aggeodata, which downloads CHIRPS, CHIRTS, AgERA5, NASA POWER and SoilGrids data and builds the input datacubes. Simulations are configured with a validated YAML file and can be run from the command line, from Python or through an MCP server for AI agents.

The package powers the spatial-crop-modeler AI agent skill of the CGIAR Climate Data Hub, developed in collaboration with AgWise (CGIAR Sustainable Farming Program) to make spatial crop modelling possible from simple prompts.
